top5.title: The influence of canine parvovirus infection on the metabolome of captive Chinese and Malaysia pangolins
top5.why: CPV infection dysregulates distinct metabolic pathways in pangolins, with Malaysian species showing lipid metabolism and ferroptosis alterations while Chinese species display amino acid and bile acid dysregulation.

top5.title: iPSC-derived retinal organoids: Biological insights and progress toward photoreceptor replacement therapy
top5.why: iPSC-derived retinal organoid transplantation demonstrates functional synaptic integration with host retina and has achieved initial clinical application for photoreceptor replacement.

top5.title: The role of fibronectin in the tumor microenvironment - implications for immunotherapy
top5.why: Oncofetal fibronectin isoforms promote vascular remodeling, EMT, pre-metastatic niche formation, and immunosuppression, positioning them as biomarkers and therapeutic targets in solid tumors.

top5.title: Transplantation of Elderly Human Gut Microbiota Into Pigs Reprograms Intestinal Barrier Function, Plasma Metabolome, and Gut Mucosal Transcriptomic Landscape
top5.why: Elderly-derived microbiota transplantation impairs intestinal barrier function through reduced tight junction proteins and altered metabolites including prostaglandin E3, with seven interferon-response genes consistently downregulated.

top5.title: Eggerthella lenta disrupts the gut vascular barrier to drive colorectal cancer liver metastasis
top5.why: Eggerthella lenta disrupts the gut vascular barrier through TLR4-dependent endoplasmic reticulum stress and PERK activation, promoting colorectal cancer liver metastasis.

also.title: Environmental circulation of multiple avian influenza subtypes and potential association with human infections in central China
also.why: Live poultry markets show seven-fold higher avian influenza detection rates, with increasing circulation of H9N2, H5N6, and H3N8 subtypes linked to human infections through phylogenetic analysis.

also.title: METTL3/IGF2BP1 Axis Orchestrates m6A-Dependent NCAM1 Preservation to Combat Age-Related Cognitive Decline
also.why: METTL3-mediated m6A modification stabilizes NCAM1 mRNA via IGF2BP1, activating CREB signaling to preserve cognition in aging mice.

also.title: MCUB restricts mitochondrial calcium to support metabolic adaptation and homeostasis in glioblastoma
also.why: MCUB restricts mitochondrial calcium to enforce glycolysis in glioblastoma, and disrupting MCUB-MCU interaction sensitizes tumors to radiotherapy.

also.title: The Role of Broad in Regulating Border Cell Migration During Drosophila Oogenesis
also.why: Broad suppression by JAK/STAT signaling is required for border cell migration during Drosophila oogenesis through coordinated changes in cell migration and junction assembly genes.

also.title: SCRMP-mediated SUMOylation of CSNK2B facilitates DNA damage repair to promote cisplatin resistance in small cell lung cancer
also.why: SCRMP, a microprotein from a noncanonical ORF, promotes cisplatin resistance in SCLC by SUMOylating CSNK2B to enhance DNA damage repair gene expression.

also.title: Galectin-3 restrains T cell-driven inflammation in the testis and epididymis
also.why: Galectin-3 suppresses T cell activation and pro-inflammatory macrophage responses in testicular and epididymal tissue, preventing autoimmune-driven organ damage and infertility.
